items.q: How long does the report take?
items.a: Within 24 hours. In complex cases (slow sources or extra validations), up to 48 hours max.
Yes. Every plan includes the full Carfax report with accident history, owners, maintenance records, and more.
Only if the vehicle went through an auction (Copart, IAAI, Manheim, ADESA). If there's no auction history, we say so explicitly in the report.

items.q: What data do I need to send?
items.a: VIN + asking price + ZIP code. Current mileage and photos are optional but help improve the AI analysis.
No. CarVeri is data, risk, and market-value analysis. We always recommend a professional mechanical inspection before buying.

items.q: Can I see a real report before buying?
items.a: Yes. Browse real CarVeri reports in the Examples section above — full reports, open and readable, before you spend a dime.

items.q: What if the car has no history?
items.a: If Carfax has no data on the vehicle, we'll let you know and it won't count as a used report. You only pay for reports with real information.

footer.disclaimer: CarVeri is a vehicle data analysis service. It does not replace a professional mechanical inspection. Results are based on information available from the sources consulted at the time the report was generated.
